data.heading: Mammals
data.text: Female mammals can feed their babies milk from their mammary glands.
Mammals have hair or fur on their body.
Placental mammals give birth to their young who are well-developed when they are born.
Marsupials are mammals that give birth to only partly developed young ones.
Monotremes are mammals that lay eggs.
There are only two monotremes, the platypus and the echidna. Both are found in Australia and Papua New Guinea.
The only mammal that can fly is the bat.
